You can really sink your teeth into the thick, meaty flesh.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Carps are a type of [[Roasted Food]], resulting from [[Mighty Carp]], [[Armored Carp]], or [[Sanke Carp]] that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} [[Blue Hinox]]es may also drop them when killed by [[Link]]. The roasting process is said to remove some of the stench of raw Carp. Link can restore one and a half of his [[Heart]]s by eating a Roasted Carp. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Carps reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Mighty Carp]], [[Armored Carp]] to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. The roasting process is said to remove some of the stench of raw Carp. Link can restore one and a half of his [[Heart]]s by eating a Roasted Carp. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Carp * Food * Frozen Carp * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Roasted Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
